reviewFixes.summary: Review blockers fixed on the PR branches: memo-bound chain verification and one hash per card; owner-object card policy; whole-token evidence rules; guarded alarm with background re-verification, receipt backoff, quarantine and retention; boot validation of ACTION_PROPOSALS_*; topic execution window and permit re-issue; grant merges only under the existing expiry; concurrent grant refusal; 409 vs 503; authority-only fingerprints; parallel grant and history reads. Third pass (topic adapters): the topic store is optional at boot and every owner-object use is guarded; the alarm and the channel poll spend the attempt before reading references and quarantine unreadable rows; every authority read is typed on leaving its budget (transport failures 503, rejected authority content 409 without schema dumps); a grant reference proved to be another transaction is set aside and replaceable, a memo-bound transaction with other messages blocks the card; step records and permits carry the identity-only executor. Transfer cards (362) follow the same rule: a hash proved to be another transaction is replaceable, a transaction carrying the card memo with other messages blocks the card (lifecycle.executionBlockedAt, additive on the unknown variant); the topic capability tests live on the topic branch only, so 362 typechecks alone. Fourth pass: each store independent in the alarm, the channel poll and the receipt mirror; 503 (not 404 or 500) while a store is down; TopicProtocolError and transient reads typed; a hash mismatch is retried, only a memo mismatch sets a reference aside.
